description: This file defines the RocksDBPersistenceEngine class, which implements a persistence engine using RocksDB for storage within the Spark deploy master component. It handles database setup, configuration, and provides methods for persisting, unpersisting, and reading data objects.

classes.name: RocksDBPersistenceEngine
classes.description: A class that provides persistence of objects in RocksDB, with configuration for compression and filtering, used within Spark's master deployment component.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Serializes an object and stores it in RocksDB under the given name.

methods.name: unpersist
methods.description: Deletes the stored object associated with the given name from RocksDB.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads and deserializes all objects stored with keys starting with the given name.
